propositions: Introduce a dedicated GET-rotation module to manage fail-open sidecar load/save and accessor functions, reading the chronological maximum of sidecar and legacy inline values per Jira key.
Dual-write every new rotation stamp to both .bridge_state/get_rotation.json and the legacy inline field during the rollout window to support interleaved old and new binary execution.
Persist the rotation sidecar only through BindingStore.save() paths (end-of-pass, write-ahead, recovery, retirement) while ensuring reconcile-check with persist=False never reaches save paths.
Extract outbound wrappers from outbound_differ.py to keep it at or below 800 lines while wiring BindingStore and outbound_differ to shared rotation accessors.
Include GET_ROTATION_FILE as an explicit local staging entry in reconcile_helpers.py so both dual-written files commit together without git add -A.
Legacy-only binding stores must preserve rotation order on load and materialize equivalent sidecar state on the next persisted save, enabling zero-impact migration.
